findings.title: Opaque no-DI BPMN is not exercised through a later targeted mutation
findings.why_it_matters: The new no-DI case proves import-time serialization preserves an unexposed bpmn:Transaction and a flow connected to it, but it never mutates the visible task afterward. The bead's regression is specifically a later edit rebuilding a reduced document, and the retained serializer has different managed-index/DI synchronization work after updateElement than on the import commit. A regression that drops opaque constructs only after a later mutation would therefore leave all six focused tests green.
findings.suggested_fix: After importing the no-DI XML, rename Task_Visible (or add a separate supported task), restore only that expected name in canonical comparison, and assert Transaction_Opaque plus Flow_Opaque still exist with the original sourceRef/targetRef. Keep the no-DI assertion so the case also proves no artificial BPMNDiagram was introduced.
evidence: tests/integration/import-roundtrip.test.ts:119-135 calls importXml(noDi), inspects the parsed indexes, and directly exports; it makes no createElement, connect, updateElement, deleteElement, save, or loadDiagram call after import.

The acceptance criterion and bead reproduction both require preserving unrelated semantics after a later mutation, while the fixture's opaque Transaction_Opaque and Flow_Opaque are exactly the constructs excluded from the typed mutation index.
The normal rich-fixture rename test does mutate after import, but it contains no unexposed bpmn:Transaction/no-DI flow pair, so it cannot cover this branch of retained content.

residual_risks: The add/connect/reopen test verifies selected extension, condition, and label values but does not canonicalize the complete rich fixture after subtracting the expected added node/flow; the required rename mutation already supplies a full canonical preservation check.
Malformed-import rollback is verified at the engine API boundary; handler/context rollback is covered elsewhere rather than in this focused fixture suite.
testing_gaps: Apply a targeted mutation in the no-DI/opaque fixture before asserting canonical preservation of the unexposed transaction and its flow.
